phases.label: Installation
phases.reason:
We will install the backyard product spine (one path, no install loops):

  - product foundations: loctree / aicx (canonical product installers)
  - vc-frame donor BINARY built from sibling source and installed only by
    Vibecrafted (no companion installer or release channel)
  - framework-owned support tools when needed
  - frontier config + operator scripts (Composer / Super binds projection)
  - shared skills, launchers, and mirrored agent views
  - the selected runtime horse when RUNTIME=... is provided
  - the Python CLI and MCP packages through uv tool install
  - vendored foundation binaries from bin/vendor/<platform> when present
  - Rust app/server binaries (voc, vc-admin, vc-server) in ~/.local/bin

The public macOS install is one Vibecrafted.app carrying vc-terminal, vc-frame,
vc-start, and the Vibecrafted runtime. It does not rewrite user shell or terminal
configuration; the app injects only its bundled environment at process start.

The public macOS install is one Vibecrafted.app carrying vc-terminal, vc-frame,
vc-start, and the Vibecrafted runtime. It does not rewrite user shell or terminal
configuration; the app injects only its bundled environment at process start.
commands:
bash -e -c 'bash scripts/install-foundations.sh
bash scripts/install-runtime.sh --runtime "${VIBECRAFTED_RUNTIME:-none}" --yes
make --no-print-directory install-vendored-binaries
make --no-print-directory install-app-binaries
make --no-print-directory install-bundle-tools
stable_root="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/vibecrafted/tools/vibecrafted-current"
bash "$stable_root/vibecrafted-core/vibecrafted_core/runtime/scripts/install-frontier-config.sh" --source "$stable_root" || printf '"'"'[warn] Frontier config skipped (non-fatal)\n'"'"'
# Project Super binds + operator scripts onto frontier (living install path).
if command -v vibecrafted >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  vibecrafted config install || printf '"'"'[warn] vibecrafted config install skipped (non-fatal)\n'"'"'
elif [[ -x scripts/vetcoders_install.py ]]; then
  python3 -c "from vibecrafted_core.vc_frame_delivery import stage_vc_frame_config; print(stage_vc_frame_config().render())" 2>/dev/null \
    || printf '"'"'[warn] config projection skipped (non-fatal)\n'"'"'
fi
'

phases.label: Onboarding
phases.reason:
Health check, then the product question:

  Launch Vibecrafted now? [Y/n]

On Y we open the operator session (vc-start) with the Start here tab —
the map of the workspace (rail, chrome, keys). That is onboarding content
already in the frame layout; the installer only wires the door.

Restore honesty: layout/session resurrection is frame-level. Full agent
process freeze is NOT claimed here (docs/installer/RESTORE_CONTRACT.md).
